description: FROZEN M2 API examples (A-owned, published for B/D). Extends M1 endpoints (docs/collab/M1/api-examples.json) — same revision/request_id/replay semantics, same error shapes. State sections per docs/collab/M2/02-contract.md; phase/cursor semantics per docs/collab/M2/phase-map.md v3. available_actions entries now carry category/inputs/known_costs/limits. Person ids are canonical person_id UUIDs.

loan._policy: APPROVED POLICY #3: loan-financed university years accrue debt EACH YEAR (randint 5000-10000 per financed year) — no graduation lump sum. has_loan becomes true after the first financed year and reflects the accrued balance minus repayments (debt_service runs each year). funded_by shows the enrollment-time funding choice.

annual_estimate._policy: deterministic preview at the retention mean (U(0.4,0.8) -> 0.6); the actual retention is sampled once per account/turn at year close; previews never consume gameplay RNG and are never posted

disabled_action_example._comment: used actions and ineligible actions are projected with enabled:false and a precise reason
disabled_action_example.label: Study harder

pending_multiphase_example._comment: family_events phase, divorce choice stored with pre-sampled outcomes; resolving advances the cursor within the phase, never reruns it

pending_decision.title: Divorce
pending_decision.text: Your partner wants a divorce. What will you do?

pending_with_inputs_example._comment: baby naming: bounded text input; private sampled data stays server-side

paid_action_rejection_example._comment: plastic surgery at insufficient funds: typed 409, state unchanged, no RNG consumed

work_income_turn_example._comment: one committed age_up spans phases; journal year entry records ACTUAL deltas; ledger legs sum exactly: gross - tax - expenses == net
work_income_turn_example._invariant: 40000 - 5800 - 12000 == 22200 exactly; debt repayment is an additional posting, never pre-deducted. APPROVED ORDERING: end-of-year accounting — relation deaths are processed after income in family_events; the deceased earned this period and inheritance posts there; player mortality is checked before decision_offer.

succession_example._comment: FROZEN M2c continue-as-child shapes. When status is 'dead', state carries succession.eligible; the client POSTs action 'continue_as' with the chosen child. Same game_id, generation+1.
response_notes: same game_id; generation increments; status back to 'alive'
the successor IS the same person: person_id, appearance and name carried over
cash inheritance posts as balanced ledger legs (share to successor + estate residual), group_id 'succession'
completed_lives gains the finished record; the deceased moves to the archive so every old journal reference still resolves
reconstructed parents/siblings keep their canonical person_ids and appearances
errors: 404 not_found (unknown target), 409 not_allowed (target not eligible / life not over)

error.message: hours must be an integer between 20 and 80
expected_revision 5 does not match current revision 7
resolve the pending decision before other actions
request_id was already used with a different payload
the operation failed; no changes were applied

compatibility.m1_fields: all M1 state fields remain supported; new sections are additive
compatibility.replay: unchanged semantics; replay checked before revision; creation replay returns original response
compatibility.estimate_policy: annual_estimate is a preview computed from current state; it is never posted and never sampled with gameplay RNG
